question: Will the Bank of Israel make no change to the Bank of Israel Interest Rate after the October decision?
resolution_criteria: Yes if the Bank of Israel leaves its policy rate unchanged at its October 21, 2026 decision, per the Bank of Israel announcement. Resolves with Polymarket market will-the-bank-of-israel-make-no-change-to-the-bank-of-israel-interest-rate-after-the-october-decision.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 93.0% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved yes per the Polymarket market. Our last number was 95.1%, the market's at entry 93.0%. The longshot rule helped on this one.
